_comment: Real pages the live check drives. Job postings rot quickly, so these are
boards and entry points rather than individual requisitions. Replace a URL
as soon as it stops resolving -- an unreachable target is reported as a
warning, and only a page that is read wrongly counts as a failure.
expect_kind is what surface detection must say. never_kind lists what it
must never say, which is where the real regressions show up: the change
that made every application look like a login page passed every fixture.
